methodology.gc: explicit before each iteration; default V8 heap
methodology.fileRead: sequential filesystem UTF-8 reads; OS cache uncontrolled and likely warm
methodology.timing: perf_hooks performance.now; milliseconds; synchronous stage boundaries
methodology.validation: parse includes structural validation; compare includes key validation, indexing and diff; internal stages cannot be measured independently without intrusive instrumentation
methodology.memory: process.memoryUsage snapshots at stage boundaries, not peak heap or isolated stage allocations; resourceUsage.maxRSS process high-water KiB; V8/GC and retained inputs/exports included
methodology.p95: nearest-rank empirical quantile; with five runs this is the observed maximum, NOT a statistically robust tail estimate
methodology.export: JSON serialization and HTML rendering timed separately; no disk output timing in export
methodology.concurrency: one benchmark child at a time; other host applications uncontrolled
